abstract: We report an experiment to demonstrate a quantum permutation determining algorithm with linear optical system. By employing photon polarization and spatial modes, we realize the quantum ququart states and all the essential permutation transformations. Compared with the classical case, this work determines the parity of the permutation in only one step of evaluation and displays the remarkable speedup of quantum algorithm. This experiment is accomplished in single photon level and exhibits strong universality in quantum computation.

specification.problem: Experimentally demonstrate a quantum permutation-parity determining algorithm using linear optics: photon polarization and spatial modes encode ququart states and implement the permutation transformations, determining permutation parity in a single evaluation step.
